if: a receipt voucher is issued under rule 50 for an advance
at the time of receipt of the advance the rate of tax or the nature of the supply is not determinable
then: where the rate is not determinable, tax is paid at eighteen per cent.; where the nature of supply is not determinable, the supply is treated as an inter-State supply
note: The only rate stated anywhere in this chapter. It is a fallback for advances, not a rate for a supply, and must never be used as the tax rate on an invoice.

evidence.extraction_note: The clause ends 'inter-State supply.' but the extraction breaks the line inside the compound, giving 'inter-' at the end of one line and 'State supply.' at the start of the next, so 'inter-State' cannot be quoted across the break.
